motion.name: perspective-turn
motion.purpose: Notebook blur resolves after selecting a portrait; disabled with reduced motion

components.name: Text navigation
components.description: Underlined hover and warm focus ring

narrative.overview: A blackened green gallery wall holds warm faceted portrait art. The interface is reserved but not anonymous: brass identifies the current perspective and action, while a broad teal surface gives reading its own space.
keyCharacteristics: Real portrait artwork, not geometric CSS substitutes.
Uneven scale and open space rather than service-card grids.
Serif display lettering with restrained sans-serif reading type.

rules.name: The Active Frame Rule
rules.body: Selection changes the frame, not just a tiny indicator.

dos: Do use art and varied scale to carry personal identity.
Do keep professional copy connected to real user problems and employed experience.
Do disable animated blur and lift transitions for reduced motion.
donts: Don't introduce claims, testimonials or case studies without evidence.
Don't turn contact demonstration into implied delivery or collection.
